name: Form
layerWhy: It holds fields and says when they are all right; the job a form does belongs to the cell around it.
promise: Pressing its main action either sends a complete answer or shows exactly what is missing.
expectation: On submit, every wrong field shows its message and focus goes to the first.
evidence: The browser's bubbles are off; (validSubmit) fires only when every field is valid.
behaviour: novalidate; errors under fields on submit.
Focus moves to the first field that needs attention.
Reset returns every field to untouched.
context: Any group of fields sent together.
relationships: Its actions sit a section gap under the last field (.pr-form-actions).
accessibility: Focus moves to what needs attention, so a keyboard user lands on it.
failures: Never clears what was typed on an error.
do: One primary action, worded by what it does.
dont: Validating while the person is still typing their first try.
